---
title: "Braintalks"
description: "Braintalks, the research colloquium of the BPCN department: guest talks, research reports, and a journal club."
---

The **Braintalks** are the seminar series of the department. They bring together guest talks, research reports from members of the department, and a journal club.

## When and where

- **Mondays at 14:00**, during the semester.
- **Hybrid:** in person at the department (JenTower, 18th floor) and on Zoom.
- **Who:** members of the department, doctoral candidates, and students writing their master's or bachelor's thesis in the department are invited to take part.

The programme for the current semester is listed in [Friedolin](https://friedolin.uni-jena.de) under the colloquium "Kolloquium Biologische Psychologie und Kognitive Neurowissenschaften". For a Zoom invitation, contact {{< var pi.name >}} at [{{< var contact.email >}}](mailto:{{< var contact.email >}}).

## Recent guest talks

- **Attila Keresztes** (Max Planck Institute for Human Development, Berlin): *A critical look at mediotemporal lobe computations supporting memory specificity across the lifespan.* 23 April 2024.
- **Manuela Nowotny** (Institute of Zoology, Friedrich Schiller University Jena): *Neuronal integration of sound-induced responses in a miniaturized insect ear.* 22 May 2023.
- **Daniela Sammler** (Frankfurt): *Music production in the broader context of cognition.* 16 January 2023.
- **Ana Chica** (University of Granada): talks on decoding conscious awareness with EEG, and on TMS, attention, and consciousness.

Programmes from earlier semesters, back to 2017/18, are archived on the [department's Braintalks page](https://www.fsv.uni-jena.de/22868/braintalks).
